rule: Crop the single colour-0 panel. For each legend dot of colour c at panel column 1 (odd rows), fill that row with n dots of colour c at columns 1,3,...,2n-1, where n is the number of 8-connected shapes of colour c outside the panel. Colours not in the legend are ignored.
scope: Count eight-connected objects by legend colour using fresh procedural masks or named fixture sprites.
constraints: Read source against archived object-counting mechanism and fixtures.

known_limitations: Default counts are positive and small; zero-count and overflow regimes are not sampled.
Procedural masks use boxes up to 4x5 and at most 12 cells.
Legend remains at column 1 on odd panel rows; same-colour objects remain separated.

authored_scope: Random scenes vary the background colour, the grid size (14..30 per side by default, any size up to 30 when requested), and the panel size and position. They use 2-4 legend colours with per-colour counts of 1..min(pw//2,5); at least one count is 2 or more. They add 0-2 distractor colours and use 15 sprite types, including diagonal-only connected ones. Grid sizes above the fixture range (20-25) are synthetic extensions. Explicit latent shapes reproduce all fixtures. Not supported: zero-count legend colours in random scenes, counts that overflow the panel width (the reference truncates them), touching shapes, and legends outside column 1.
authored_constraints: Exactly one colour-0 rectangle; background, legend and shape colours are all non-zero
Legend colours are distinct and differ from the background; distractor colours are disjoint from the legend and background
Every shape is placed with a one-cell gap (no 8-adjacency) from every other shape and from the panel, so each shape is exactly one component
2*count <= panel width for every legend colour, so no dots are truncated
The background is strictly the most frequent colour of the input
Panel height >= 2*len(legend)+1 and panel width >= 3 (5 or more when sampled)
Random scenes have at least one count >= 2 when the panel width allows it, so the panel is not left unchanged
